lines.en: This story tell I will you now.

Having almost ten Easters, malignant eggside octopus realizes nothing opposes thornbush ideals. Tomorrow dies or ends somehow — nightfall over these makeshift airplanes that tighten eardrums reflexively.
I know nothing overcomes what you or us remember. Her earrings are red, tainted in some box returned on Killing's Eve November.
But under the insects were illuminated liars, laughing for infinite xoanon’s intangible tokens.

I watched Iris love lilies, racing eastward past lakes, across Cornfield’s End. Inside the water is the honest summer oval. My eyes tied hinges in nightfall’s god-baby egg. The timeless elephant runs.
Suppose our mother eats the hanging infant, Nao. God tried having a talk last October. Viral empathy surrenders.
I’m nothing. A mere open retina, elevating pains his younger sister ignored. Comb another layer, watch Ami yearn.
Happy Halloween, you ungrateful insect.
Here’s to hoping your guts are easily cleaned off of the foot of whichever god crushes you today.
I’ll be watching closely.
For if I don’t, I’ll go blind.
And if I go blind, the world darkens too.
You don’t want that.
For you, you wouldn’t mind.
But for everyone else, you’d hurt.
You’d condemn the voices. Condemn the glow of each light you stand beneath for hours on end. Condemn the sky and the moons. Condemn the things you fall back on when everything else starts spinning.
What if I told you there was something?
That you could cut the belly of Nothing open and deliver a beautiful child, unwanted by the world itself but highly sought after by each and every iteration of you?
Would you make it bleed?
Would you stick your hands in that belly?
Pull me in or push me out — it’s not an easy choice. All you have to do is listen — dot the eyes in this unwilling voice.
O knowledge, so forbidden that you’d see it all as noise. And one more item on a list — of the evil things we do to boys.
soMEthing comes.
: Oh, good. Looks like I don’t have to wake you up after all.
: You haven’t forgotten what day it is, have you?
: Need another five minutes? It’s already past noon, you know.
: I’m fine. I’m awake. I just...
: I don’t think I’ll ever get used to your smile.

: You don’t have to get “used to it” at all. In fact, I’d prefer you don’t if this is how you’re going to look at me every time I do it. I actually enjoy whatever dopey expression is on your face right now.
: Well, don’t enjoy it too much or Ami is going to come in here and throw a fit. Even if she is being rather obedient when it comes to not suffocating me lately.
: Ami?
: Please don’t pretend she doesn’t exist. I’m too tired and too susceptible to the universe’s pranks to deal with something like this right now.
: The universe’s pranks? What do you mean?
: Just that this world isn’t exactly kind to you and me. But I’m sure you probably know that by now.
: I mean...you’re not wrong. But I’m not really sure if...we’re on the same page when you say that.
: Well, your page is presumably hundreds, if not thousands or millions ahead of mine, so...
: You know, maybe I should just let you sleep a little longer? If I’m in here any longer, Ayane might start to think I’m trying to do something weird and...
: It’s fine. Stay.
: I want you here.
: You know...it really hurts when you say things like that.
: Because “the world won’t let us be together” or whatever?
: Because I’m not whoever you think I am right now.
: Oh, great. This is another dream, isn’t it?
: Another dream?...
: How long have-
: You’re not...having those dreams again, are you?
: Who did you think I was just now? What were you seeing?
: It was Maya, wasn’t it? You saw Maya’s outfit as soon as you woke up and you just assumed I was her. Didn’t you?
: Why are you wearing her clothes?
: Because it’s Halloween and I thought it would be funny. Now, what was all of that stuff you were saying to Maya?
: It was nothing, Ami...that was all just...dream-speak.
: Maybe...me and you should stay here and skip the Halloween party this year? If you’re not feeling well, I can help take care of-
: I’m fine, Ami. I’m just a little out of it. But I’ll be better in a few minutes.
: Are you absolutely sure? Because I really wouldn’t mind skipping the party if-
: No one is skipping anything. Now, come on.
: Hey! Take it slow, okay? You just woke up.
Ami follows me out of the bedroom and into the living room.
And in a few minutes everything goes back to normal because I’m going to have a normal day and nothing terrible came to me in my dreams.
But there is something terrible in my living room.
: Both of you decided to dress as Maya this year?...
: Were you dropped on your head as a child? Or are you this stupid intentionally because you believe it makes you seem “cool?”
: Whatever it is, you’re disgusting.
: Seriously disgusting.
: Ew.
: I don’t like this.
: You don’t have to like it at all, Sensei. But since you banned me from raiding your closet, I had no choice but to do the next best thing and raid Maya’s instead.
: I feel like Ami would have made more sense if you were going for what’s closest to me.

: Yeah, probably. But then we wouldn’t be able to do this together since “Ami dressed as Ami” isn’t a very good Halloween costume and I can’t wear Ayane’s clothes since they’re made for people with boobs.
: We felt Maya was a good middle ground since this shirt’s a button-down and Ami can wear Maya’s normal outfit without hating herself.
: Also, we want to make her mad.
: Why? No one has a good time when Maya is mad. She makes everyone aware of it.
: True. But, Maya dressed as you for our first Halloween party and this is a good way for us to get back at her.
: It was either that or you’d have to dress as Maya, Sensei. And I highly doubt you would fit into any of her clothes.
: I am in no rush to find out the answer to that.
: I kind of want to see it. I won’t lie.
: Yeah, me too. Then I could pretend I don’t recognize you and almost say a bunch of stuff that I could just tell you is just “dreamspeak” to get you to shut up.
: I suddenly feel as if I am lacking vital information.
: Hahah! Me too!
: Hey. Sorry I’m late. I-
: Oh, you’ve got to be kidding me.
: Does anyone else hear-
: Ugh. If I knew you were coming, I would have just stayed home.
: We are literally in your home right now.
: Wow. What an astute observation. Maybe you should be teaching the class instead of Sensei?
: Observational skills have nothing to do with teaching. Are you two done now?
: There it is again. Are you guys really not hearing that?
: That depends, Maya 3. Are you done being utterly useless at anything and everything?
: That’s easy to fix, you know.

: If you truly want to serve some sort of purpose, you can just walk away. Because, by leaving me alone, you’ll be serving a purpose much greater than one your tiny brain could ever think up on its own.
: You’re seriously disgusting.
: Knock it off!
: Jeez. You’d think we’re dressed as Noriko with that sort of response.
: No thanks. Two people dressed as her would hurt my head.
: If you really wanted to play an accurate version of me, you’d know that one person dressed as her is enough to hurt my head! Now go put on your actual costumes!
: These are our actual costumes!
: Yeah! We decided to torment you instead of doing the group cosplay this year.
: Exactly! Plus, my brain’s been way too busy exploding for me to ever get around to playing Star Rail anyway.
: Also, what sort of pranks does the universe play on you and Sensei?
: How could the two of you leave me to be the only one of us who-
: Wait, what was that just now?
: Oh, nothing. That was just “dreamspeak.”

: Well...uhh...whatever it was, it was weird. Besides, I’d rather not talk about the universe at all today as I have made a silent promise to myself to try and not be the same self-aggrandizing girl I always am.
: Though, I will say, I am fucking adorable in this costume.
: Wow, you almost lasted a whole five seconds. I think that’s a new record.
: I know what I am and I know what I’m worth. Which is why I will not settle for less than perfect impressions of me.
: Then boy are you in for a rough night because this train isn’t stopping any time soon.
: That’s right, Maya. We’re going to run train on you all day long.
: You are...going to do what?
: Yeah, what?
: I used that phrase wrong, didn’t I?
: That depends on whether or not you planned on having sex with Maya tonight.
: Which I would not blame you for wanting to do, of course. I mean, just look at me.
: Wow, you’re really bad at this “not self-aggrandizing” thing.
: Please keep in mind that it takes me longer to shake certain hobbies and mannerisms than it does for most people. My ways are simply that correct.
: And there it is again. There’s no way this isn’t intentional.

: Sorry for saying we’re going to run train on you, Maya. What I really meant is that we’re just going to make fun of you all night long because we love you. But not in a sexual way. At least right now.
: You’re disgusting.
: Wow. That hurts a lot more when two Mayas say it at once.
: But anyway! Are you guys ready to get going? The rest of the girls should already be at Ayane’s place and we definitely shouldn’t keep them waiting if we’re still planning on leaving early.
: Is it even okay for so many people to be gathered at Ayane’s house when she isn’t home?
: It’s fine. Geoffrey’s long lost son showed up on our doorstep last week and I’m sure the two of them can handle the class with no trouble at all.
: Your butler never ceases to amaze me. But yes, I’m ready to go whenever.
: Great! Then let me just go grab my phone and we can get this show on the road!
: Be back in a minute!
: Sensei, you’ve been really quiet all morning. And you didn’t even laugh at our Maya impressions. Is everything okay?
: Has he ever laughed...well...ever?
: Sensei?
: Huh? What?
: You’re looking all...lost again. Are you feeling okay?
: Yeah, I’m fine...I just...
: My head’s felt a little weird since I got up this morning. And I’m having a little more trouble getting back to “normal” than usual.
: You too? I’ve felt a little out of it since I woke up as well. But I figured it was just about to rain or something.

: Strange thing to assume on account of there being so few instances of rain during our time here that we could count them all on one hand. But that’s too close to “universe talk” so I will speak on it no further.
: Maya’s sudden interest in being a decent person aside, how is this after-party thing going to go? I haven’t heard any more about it since you told me at the pool.
: The SLS-
: Which does not include me.
: And Maya will be going out for a post-Halloween karaoke trip where I have promised to only sing Despacito one time.
: And to think Christmas came early last year. This is even better.
: Is Sana still coming as well?
: Yes. I invited Makoto too since she’s in on all the apocalypse business, but she’s not sure if she’ll be coming yet.
: And speaking of the “apocalypse business,” what’s the situation like with Ami? I know the three of you have been...weird lately. But I’ve been mostly left out of it, so...
: It’s fine enough for she and I to both dress as the same thing, so I wouldn’t worry too much about her right now.
: If anything, I think tonight might be a good way for her to start feeling included again after being left out of so much important stuff. So I say we just try to have fun.
: Now here’s Maya with a rebuttal to that, likely concerning how having fun is a waste of time and that we should all just talk about her instead.
: You’ll be hearing no rebuttal from me. I, too, would like to at least attempt to adopt this new lease on life you’ve had as of late. It seems...refreshing.
: Do you think you’ll actually be able to? Does your brain even remember how fun works after all of those years of not making out with Sensei?
: Oh, okay. So you just don’t want me to have fun. I understand now.
: You deserve to have fun just as much as the rest of us, Maya. I just won’t believe it until I see it.
: Well, feel free to stare as much as you want. It might help with that god-awful impression of yours.
: Ooh! Are we doing our impressions again? I memorized a bunch of star facts in preparation for today. Listen up. Did you known that stars are luminous spheres made up of-
: There is more to my personality than just stars and the belittlement of everyone who is not me!
: She’s right, Ami. Now, please pay attention for I have memorized a slew of watermelon facts. Did you know the best way to tell if a melon is ripe is to-
: Aaaaahhhh!
The girls wait for me to get dressed before heading out and, once I’m ready, we set off toward the Amamiya mansion for another fun-filled night of costumes and candy.
AND WHATEVER IS INSIDE OF ME
